selection.ownership: Galamian Pty Ltd, operator of eSignatures.com (formerly esignatures.io). Australian company; global e-sign product, not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official eSignatures.com API (host https://esignatures.com/api, HTTP Basic with Secret Token as username and empty password, GET /templates, GET /templates/{id}, GET /templates/{id}/content, GET /contracts/{id}, adaptive rate limiting, avoid polling contracts), Galamian Pty Ltd terms identity, privacy policy, ISO 27001/compliance pages, and dated incident search. Dropbox Sign / HelloSign 2024 and other unrelated e-sign incidents were distinguished. No qualifying current unresolved eSignatures.com compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official eSignatures.com API documents HTTPS host https://esignatures.com/api, HTTP Basic with Secret Token as username and empty password (optional token query is omitted), GET /templates, GET /templates/{template_id}, GET /templates/{template_id}/content, and GET /contracts/{contract_id}. Operator is Galamian Pty Ltd. Product currently brands as eSignatures.com; pinned upstream id remains esignatures_io. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved eSignatures.com compromise.

incidents.finding: Bounded search distinguished eSignatures.com / Galamian Pty Ltd from Dropbox Sign (HelloSign) 2024 and other unrelated e-sign incidents. No current unresolved eSignatures.com customer-data compromise was identified.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified. Official docs warn against polling GET /contracts/{id}; webhooks are preferred for status.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /templates, matching the pinned validator. Native Basic auth uses http.auth.basic with the secret token as username and an empty password. The optional token query parameter is omitted.
Native category is productivity: eSignatures.com is an e-sign product and there is no documents/legal CATEGORIES value.
The upstream user-agent is not sent. Writes (create/withdraw) are omitted. Responses keep raw provider JSON under data instead of the source template unwrap.
Returns raw eSignatures.com JSON under data for GET /templates. Same path as healthcheck; this operation is the explicit list.
templateId is a required non-empty string path segment on GET /templates/{templateId}. Official docs name the parameter template_id; native input keeps the pinned camelCase field and URL-encodes it.
contractId is a required non-empty string path segment on GET /contracts/{contractId}. Official docs warn against polling this endpoint; it is admitted as an on-demand read, not a healthcheck.
